Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 03-Jan-2025 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIRST SEMESTER B.Tech. (CSE STREAM) EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2024 / JANUARY 2025  
  SUBJECT: CSE 1171/CSE_1171 - PROGRAMMING FOR PROBLEM SOLVING  
  (MAKEUP/REGULAR)  
  
  
  PROGRAMMING FOR PROBLEM SOLVING [CSE 1171]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                      Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)                Draw a flowchart for swapping two numbers using "temp" variable.                                        (2)  
1B)                Differentiate between machine language, assembly language, and high-level language in the               (3)  
  context of C programming. How does the C compiler convert C code into machine code?  
1C)                i) Write a C program to determine if a student is eligible for a scholarship based on their age, GPA,   (5)  
  and the number of extracurricular activities they participate in. The criteria for eligibility are as  
  follows:  
  
  The student must be between 18 and 25 years old.  
  The student must have a GPA of 3.5 or higher.  
  The student must be involved in at least 2 extracurricular activities.  
  Use relational and logical operators to determine eligibility and print:  
  
  "Eligible for scholarship" if the student meets all criteria.  
  "Not eligible for scholarship" otherwise.  
  
  ii) Write a C program using ternary operator for the above scenario (do not use if's and switch  
  statements).  
  (3+2 = 5 marks)  
2A)                Can break be used in a nested loop? If yes, justify your answer with an example code snippet.           (2)  
2B)                Write a program in C to display the n terms of a harmonic series and their sum using a for loop.        (3)  
  Harmonic Series: 1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + 1/4 + 1/5 ... 1/n terms.  
2C)                i) Illustrate the number of swaps in each pass for the following array elements using bubble Sort.      (5)  
  Show all the intermediate steps.  
  $$Array={10, 5, 60, 14, 21}$$  
  ii) Write a C program to sort the array given in part (i) in descending order using selection sort.  
  (2+3 = 5 marks)  
3A)                Write a C program to identify the character that appears the most times in a given string. The          (2)  
  program should output both the character and its frequency.  
3B)                Develop a C program that stores and displays the odd and even integers of a given array into two        (3)  
  separate arrays.  
3C)                Compare and contrast call by value and call by reference. Develop a C program to generate and           (5)  
  display all permutations of a given string using call by reference.  
4A)                Write a program to pass an array of N elements to the function. Identify the Fibonacci numbers in       (3)  
  the received array and return the largest Fibonacci number.  
  
  Page 1 of 2

4B)   Develop a C program that implements a function to search for a specific element within a matrix.         (3)  
  The function should return 1 if the element is found, and 0 if it is not. The program should display  
  whether the given element is present in the matrix.  
4C)   Write a C program to check if a given number is palindrome using recursion. Implement input              (4)  
  validation to ensure the user enters a non-negative integer.  
5A)   Develop a C program that uses a pointer to an array to identify and display all pairs of elements        (3)  
  from the array whose sum equals a specified target value. The program should prompt the user to  
  enter the array elements and the target value.  
5B)   Write a program to read strings from an input file, "Input.txt" and write into an output file,           (3)  
  "Output.txt", deleting specific word, taken as input from console.  
5C)   Define a structure Date having three integer members day, month, and year. Write a function called (4)  
  Datecmp() which accepts two pointers to the Date structure and compares the two dates and  
  returns 1 if the first date is earlier than second one, -1 if the first date is later and 0 if two dates are  
  equal.Write a main function to test this function.  
  
  
  -----End-----  
  
  
  Page 2 of 2
